title: Israel seeks to jail Palestinian student activist without trial after dorm arrest
summary_full: Mahdi Tounsi appeared with visible bruising after being interrogated by police on his association with Israeli-Palestinian organisationsIsraeli professors, students and rights activists are calling for the immediate release of Mahdi Tounsi, a sociology student at Jerusalem’s Hebrew University who has been held without charge for more than two weeks after he was seized from his dorm room.The detention comes amid a racist campaign of delegitimisation against Palestinian citizens of Israel, whose votes were critical to stripping Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition of its majority in elections last month.
